findings.label: §2 map and §5.6 table predate two artefacts in .agents\tasks\
findings.guideLocation: §2 The repository at a glance, .agents block, lines 86-104; §5.6 .agents\tasks\ per-file table, lines 672-682
findings.detail: Both lists enumerate the contents of .agents\tasks\ and neither mentions walkthrough-review.md or walkthrough-review.json, which now exist there. git ls-files shows both are untracked, so the guide is accurate about the committed set, and the two files are output of this review loop rather than part of the template. Non-blocking.
findings.action: Optional: add a clause saying the folder also collects review artefacts from later passes, or leave the lists describing the committed set only.

findings.label: §4.4 package-group label abbreviated while claiming exactness
findings.guideLocation: §4.4 Directory.Packages.props, line 379 and the table row at line 390
findings.detail: The guide says the pinned set is "grouped exactly as the file groups it", then labels the last group "Configuration and DI" where the props file labels its ItemGroup "Configuration and dependency injection". The grouping itself and all 21 versions are correct; only the label is shortened. Non-blocking.
findings.action: Optional: use the file's own label, or soften "exactly" to "in the same groups".
